Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Soul of Meal game production sprite sheet, character Bánh tét (banh-tet), 16 NEW authored poses.
Input image is the existing CANON model identity reference, not a sheet to copy. Preserve its anatomy, colors, clothing and equipment exactly. Ignore any old background glow/noise.
Subject: An ivory/mint anthropomorphic rabbit with very long green-edged ears, big dark-green eyes, tiny pink nose, pink blossom forehead wreath; mint robe with ivory lapels and vivid purple sash/bow. A tall green banana-leaf cylindrical banh-tet rice-cake pack tied with red/pink ribbons and pink blossoms stays strapped vertically on its back. A round golden wicker shield with green inset and central pink lotus is always held in the LEFT hand (viewer right in the reference). Bare paw feet. No staff or sword.
Style: polished cute 2.5D anime RPG, warm detailed cel shading, crisp contours, matching the reference proportions; one consistent camera, scale and lighting.
Composition: one square 2048x2048 transparent RGBA canvas, EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows of equal cells. Exactly ONE full-body character in every cell, 16 total, all facing three-quarter RIGHT. Leave a generous completely transparent margin in every cell including around ears, hats, ladles, tail, pack, arrows, shield and feet. No cell lines. Same scale across all cells. Full character may occupy 70% of each cell. Keep neighboring silhouettes disconnected.
Rows in strict row-major order:
Row 1 IDLE four distinct subtle breathing/ear/hand poses; no turn to the left.
Row 2 WALK four genuinely different step phases: left contact, left passing, right contact, right passing. Move legs, hips and arms, not just translate one drawing.
Row 3 ATTACK four distinct anticipation, windup, contact, recovery poses.
Row 4 CAST four distinct gather, raised gesture, extended contact, recover poses.
Action direction and character constraints: gentle heavy rabbit steps carrying the tall pack; attack is a compact shield push; cast is an open right palm and left shield held protectively; keep all ears, pack and ribbon ends.
Transparent background only. No aura, particles, projectile, ground, cast shadows, props detached from the actor, scenery, texts, labels, duplicate heads or motion echoes. Never clip equipment. Never replace poses with repeated copies. This is clean actor artwork; effects will be drawn by game code.

Match the first input sheet's exact body, clothing, equipment, scale and polish; it is the identity reference for additional gestures.
Rows in strict row-major order:
Row 1 ULTIMATE four distinct full-body anticipation, raised offering, protective outstretched contact, recovery. Keep actor only, no magic.
Row 2 HIT four distinct short recoil poses: brace, backward flinch, lower shield with one knee bent, regain balance.
Row 3 FALL four distinct losing-balance, kneeling, sitting exhausted, lying fainted ON THE RIGHT SIDE poses. Keep every ear, paw, shield and banana-leaf pack visible in every cell. The pack can rest behind the body. No blood.
Row 4 VICTORY four distinct smiling shield salute, joyful little hop with left foot lifted, open-palm greeting, warm bow. All remain in each cell.

Edit only the framing of this exact Soul of Meal rabbit portrait. Zoom the character OUT by about 22 percent inside the same square canvas and extend the matching soft jade/cream bokeh background. The complete tips of BOTH very long ears must be fully visible, with at least 8% empty background margin above both ears and 6% margin to the right ear tip. Keep the exact rabbit identity, face, eyes, mint fur, purple sash, banana-leaf cylindrical pack with pink ribbons and round golden lotus shield. Keep the same beautiful detailed anime cel shading and three-quarter view. Do not change the species, outfit, expression or add anything. One centered character. No text. This is for a small character UI portrait where the ears must not be clipped.

revision.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: Soul of Meal character portrait for Bánh tét (banh-tet). Create one polished square anime RPG portrait matching the supplied NEW full-body sheet and original CANON model. These inputs are identity references, not a collage to reproduce.
Subject invariants: An ivory/mint anthropomorphic rabbit with very long green-edged ears, big dark-green eyes, tiny pink nose, pink blossom forehead wreath; mint robe with ivory lapels and vivid purple sash/bow. A tall green banana-leaf cylindrical banh-tet rice-cake pack tied with red/pink ribbons and pink blossoms stays strapped vertically on its back. A round golden wicker shield with green inset and central pink lotus is always held in the LEFT hand (viewer right in the reference). Bare paw feet. No staff or sword.
Composition: one character only, chest/waist-up three-quarter view, centered friendly expressive face, clean appealing anatomy, large clear eyes, visible key hat/ears/crest, necklace or bow, and signature equipment partly visible near the shoulder/front. Keep long ears, hat, flower or crest INSIDE the square with ample margins. Preserve the exact species, clothing, color palette, proportions and equipment from the reference. Hand-drawn cel shading and detailed soft fur/feathers; coherent with the new sprite sheet. Warm soft studio lighting. Gentle abstract jade and cream bokeh background with a subtle school-colored glow, enough contrast for small UI. No text, no frame, no logos, no extra characters. Never turn the rabbit into a turtle, bull into lion, bird into fox or beaver-like creature into crane.
